definition.def: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this. [disapproval]
examples: Arbitrary arrests and detention without trial were common.

examples.sentence: Such findings present a big challenge to British conservation, which has often selected arbitrary assemblages of plants and animals and sought, at great effort and expense, to prevent them from changing.
In the same way, random, arbitrary or accidental mutations of ideas may help pave the way for advances in science.
